book.hexerei.crafting_type.crafting_tabl: To craft, you need a 3x3 crafting space and the items shown below.
book.hexerei.crafting_type.dipper: To craft, you need a Mixing Cauldron with a Dipper attached and the item and fluid shown below.
book.hexerei.crafting_type.herb_drying_r: To craft, you need a Drying Rack and the item shown below.
book.hexerei.crafting_type.mixing_cauldr: To craft, you need a Mixing Cauldron and the items shown below.
To craft, you need a heated Mixing Cauldron and the items shown below.
book.hexerei.crafting_type.pestle_and_mo: To craft, you need a Pestle and Mortar and the items shown below.
book.hexerei.crafting_type.woodcutter: To craft, you need a Woodcutter and the items shown below.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_1.passa: The Broom is the rideable mount from Hexerei. This allows witches to fly with it and with that the ability to traverse the lands with ease. Currently there are two broom types available which one is Willow and the other Mahogany.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_2.passa: First off the Willow broom. This broom is the slower of the brooms, which is nice for server exploration and nice for precise building. Though, it being slower you may have already figured out that it is easier to make for the early game.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_3.passa: Second the Mahogany broom. This broom faster than the Willow Broom, which is great for getting around faster than before. Not only is this broom faster but its item is also fire and lava resistant, but not while the broom is an entity.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_3_1.pas: Third, The Witch Hazel Broom is a reliable choice for any witch seeking a balance of speed and control. Slightly faster than the Willow Broom but not as swift as the Mahogany Broom. Crafted from the enchanting wood of the witch hazel tree, this broom is ideal for everyday travel and magical adventures alike.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_4.passa: To use the broom, right click on the ground with the broom, just like a boat. Then to ride it simply right click, and to open its GUI crouch and right click. While riding, to ascend up into the clouds hold Space and to descend back to the ground hold %kkey.hexerei.broomDescend and be sure to check the keybinds if there are conflicting keys, or change the descend key to your desired key.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_5.passa:
The rest of the broom controls act like a boat. Now that you know how to fly the broom lets get into its GUI and attachments.

 Again to access the broom simply crouch and right click the broom while it is an entity.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_6.passa: To begin there are three slots on the top of the GUI, first the Misc which is for misc attachments on the broom and usually attached to the tip. For example the Broom Chain can be attached to the broom in that slot and when the chain has an item imprinted it will display the item hanging on the chain.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_7.passa: The second slot is for the Satchel and this slot is for the satchel items, there are three tiers of attachments each tier gives an additional 9 slots to hold items within while on your travels.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_8.passa:
The last slot is for the Brush of the broom, this is the brooms power source to be able to fly. The brushes of the broom will deplete while flying around on the broom until the brushes break.
 Once the brush breaks the broom will fall to the ground, so be sure to swap out new brushes on a long journey.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_9.passa:
Attachments: 
   Misc: 
   Satchel: 
   Brush: 
 To attach, place each item into their respective slots of the broom's inventory.
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_1.passag: The Crow is the first familiar of many to come to Hexerei. They can be tamed with seed mixture, in two different ways. You can either throw the seeds onto the ground and nearby
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_10.passa: The second help mode is Harvesting and this will allow your crows to harvest any crop and some bush plants nearby the position of the crow, or nearby the position of the crow's perch. The crow will leave the items on the ground, so having another crow
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_11.passa:
that is set to gather all of those items would be quite useful! The crows will be able to harvest any of the Hexerei flowers as well.

  The last of the help modes is Pickpocketing, yes pickpocketing. Crows are able to pickpocket villagers to snag their potential trades. This has a set list for each type of villager, and can give
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_12.passa: common items like emeralds, paper, seeds, and more. Villagers do not need to be leveled up and the loot table is just based off of which job the villager has selected. Each crow has a cooldown before they can pickpocket again. For an example Librarians can give things like books and already enchanted books, which is a great source of early
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_13.passa:
enchanted books. Another example is if you are low on food the crow can go steal from some farmers or butchers to gather some easy food. 

 If you are still trying to figure out how to add a perching location to a crow you need to use the Crow Flute to direct the crow. This is the tool for directing the crows more precisely and can direct more than one
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_14.passa: crow at a time, either all of the nearby crows or the list of selected crows. The flute will tell crows which command to follow. To change the flutes given command you need to open the GUI by crouching and right clicking. When
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_15.passa:
opened you can see that it is very similar to the crows GUI except there are a few extra buttons on the bottom. For example if you set the flute to Sit and then exit the GUI and right click with the flute which will then tell all tamed crows near the player to sit.

  Now to talk about the Select and Perch.
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_16.passa: The Select button, when toggled, will change how right clicking outside of the GUI acts. This is used for commanding up to 9 selected crows, so only those crows will listen to that flutes command. When selecting crows simply right click with the flute on the crow you want selected. Once selected the crow will show a selection cube above their head based off
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_17.passa: their dye color. When one or more crows are selected, inside the GUI will show each crow selected at the bottom. To deselect crows simply right click the crow again with the select mode active. To clear all of the selected crows press the small X located next to the select button.
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_18.passa: Now that you know all about the select button lets talk about the Perch button. This button requires crows to be selected to work. When crows are selected and the perch button is toggled, exit the GUI and right click on a location, this location will be saved as all of the selected crow's perch. While the button is still toggled
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_19.passa:
you can see all of the selected crow's perch locations with big colored cubes based off of their dye color. These can be removed by clicking on that same red X next to the perch button.

  Now that you know how to control your crow its time to outfit them with names, dyes, and hats! Right click your crow with a dye to add a colored bandanna and they can be renamed similar to
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_2.passag: untamed crows will fly over and munch on them for a chance to tame, or they can just be right clicked onto the crow. Crows have a better chance of taming when the seeds are thrown onto the ground. Players are able to tame more than one crow at a time, allowing for a crow army to work with the player!
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_20.passa: the other dyeable items, like jeb_ or les_ to color change the bandanna.
With all of that said don't forget the crow's favorite snackies!
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_3.passag: Once tamed crows can be set to different commands. The player can change these commands by simply right clicking the crow, this will cycle through the 4 main commands the crows have. These commands can also be changed by opening up the crow's GUI. To open the GUI crouch and right click a tamed crow.
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_4.passag: Each crow contains 3 slots, the first being what the crow is holding, the second being the hat the crow is wearing, and the third is a misc slot still to be determined but can act as a storage slot. The crows can be equip with weapons to help fight with you.
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_5.passag: Below the item slots of the crow GUI is the commands for the crow. This is where you can set the commands and set the specific help command. The first command on the left is the Follow command, this will make the crow follow closely behind the player or hop onto the players shoulder.
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_6.passag:
The second command is the Sit command, this will make the crow land and try to sit. If the crow has a perch position it will instead fly over to that perch and sit.

  The third command is the Wander command, this will make the crow wander and fly around the area.
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_7.passag:
If the crow has a perch location the crow will not wander too far away from the perch.

  The last command is the Help command, this command is unique and has three separate modes to it. When the
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_8.passag: Help command is selected the modes on the right will gain color showing that these are in use and using the selected mode. The first of the help modes is Gathering and this will allow your crows to interact with the Coffer or Herb Jar blocks. The crows will interact with nearby
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_9.passag: coffers or Herb Jars that have the Crow Gather button toggled on. The crows will seek out any items in the area matching items already inside the container, unless the crow has a perch at the container, then it will pickup ANY item in the area and deposit it back in that container.
book.hexerei.entities_index_page_1.passa: This chapter is all about entities and how you interact with them!
book.hexerei.entities_owl_page_1.passage:
The Owl is another familiar that can assist you in your witchy needs. 
  They can be tamed with raw Cod or Salmon, in two different ways like the crow. You can either throw the fish on the ground and they will eat it and have a
book.hexerei.entities_owl_page_2.passage: better chance at taming, or you can right click them with the fish.
Owls play only the role of a messenger, for now. They can be tasked with delivering
book.hexerei.entities_owl_page_3.passage: messages to players or Owl Courier Depots. They can carry two types of deliveries: Courier Letters or Courier Packages. Courier Letters are used solely for sending messages, while Courier Packages can hold up to 5 items, making them perfect for sending small goods and treasures.
book.hexerei.entities_owl_page_4.passage:
Whether it’s a simple note or a bundle of valuable items, the owls ensure that your messages and packages reach their destination swiftly and safely.

  To send a delivery use one of the items below and right click your tamed owl.
book.hexerei.index_page_2.passage_1:
- Right click to interact -
 next page button on bottom right
book.hexerei.intro_page_1.passage_1:
Welcome to the enchanting world of Hexerei, a rich and immersive experience filled with mystical covens and enchanting creatures.

  Dive into the lore of the dark, nature, and soon to come spirit coven, each with their unique design and secrets. 

Created by: JoeFoxe
book.hexerei.intro_page_2.passage_1:
This book will guide your way through the magical world of Hexerei, helping you uncover the secrets and powers of witchcraft. 

  With more content on the horizon, including new coven witches, spells, and familiars, the world of Hexerei continues to grow and evolve. Stay tuned for even more magical adventures!
book.hexerei.intro_page_3.passage_1:
If you have not figured it out already, at the bottom corners of the opened pages should be arrows directing you to the next page or previous page.
  As well as an X which will close the book and lay it down and a Home button which will direct you to the index.
book.hexerei.intro_page_4.passage_1:
On the top left of the page is for bookmark the pages you are on, clicking it again will change the bookmarks color.
  Bookmarks will pop up on the sides and top of the pages, these can be moved around by simply right clicking, holding, and dragging to another slot.
book.hexerei.intro_page_5.passage_1:
They can be swapped with another bookmark or with an empty slot. Clicking on a bookmark will redirect you to the page that it was saved on.
  Crouch and right click the altar to pick up the book. 
  The book can be opened or closed when picked up, if left opened it will still show the pages on the book, though for now you wont be able to turn the pages in hand, it must be on an altar.
book.hexerei.intro_page_6.passage_1:
In the configs you can change the font from fancy to normal minecraft font if its hard to read or you are wanting more immersion.
  You are also able to hover items and press %kkey.hexerei.book_hovering_recipe for recipes, and %kkey.hexerei.book_hovering_uses for uses to open up the JEI page respectively
book.hexerei.items_altar_1.passage_2:
The Altar is not just for reading this book on. It can be used to display any item you place onto it, with a special surprise for anything that can be potted.

  They can be crafted out of willow and witch hazel as well.
book.hexerei.items_animal_fat_1.passage_: Animal Fat is one of the items able to be used to make tallow, as well as this book. Can be obtained by killing any Cow, Pig, or Sheep, and is effected by looting.
The berries of the Belladonna Plant are very poisonous. Many may know the other name for the belladonna plant as nightshade. These berries will be used in the future for various mixtures and blends within the pestle and mortar for infusing your candles with various effects.
Belladonna flowers are used in the recipe to make the herb enhanced broom brush, they can also be dried and later on will be used in different infuses and rituals.
  Obtained by right clicking a fully grown Belladonna Plant.
book.hexerei.items_belladonna_plant_1.pa: The most poisonous plant of Hexerei, the Belladonna, probably should not be consumed in any way unless prepared in the proper manner. These plants can be harvested by simply right clicking it when it is fully grown just like a sweet berry bush.
book.hexerei.items_blood_bottle_1.passag:
Blood is a key ingredient in the creation of flying brooms, and can be acquired by using the Blood Sigil. To get enough blood for one bottle, one needs to jump in a cauldron with the sigil three times.
  Bottles of blood can also be drank, giving Absorption to the drinker.
book.hexerei.items_blood_sigil_1.passage: The Blood Sigil is a sigil for the Mixing Cauldron, able to extract blood from entities who jump in the cauldron. The blood can then be used in recipes, or bottled or bucketed out.
book.hexerei.items_book_of_shadows_1.pas:
Your guide to the witching world of Hexerei.

 The color of the book's cover is determined by the dye used in crafting. The corners of the book can be recolored by crafting the book with another dye.
book.hexerei.items_broom_brush_1.passage: Brushes are the most important broom attachment, as they allow the broom to fly. While flying, the brush will be damaged, and will eventually break. All brushes can be enchanted with Mending and Unbreaking to offset this, however.
book.hexerei.items_broom_keychain_1.pass: A cosmetic attachment for the broom, which makes a keychain trinket of the item imprinted onto it. To imprint an item, craft the item with the chain. It fits in the Misc slot.
book.hexerei.items_broom_keychain_3.pass: The imprinted item is not consumed fully. You can retrieve it by placing the Broom Chain into a crafting grid.
book.hexerei.items_broom_netherite_tip_1: This broom attachment is very useful for nether flight, as it allows the broom to fly through lava and fire without getting damaged. This fits into the Misc slot.
book.hexerei.items_broom_seat_1.passage_: The Broom Seat is a mix between a satchel and a cosmetic seat making the rider face forwards.
book.hexerei.items_broom_stand_1.passage: The Broom Stand is the perfect solution for storing your broom when it’s not in use. Designed to be placed against the wall or on the ground, it keeps your broom secure and ready for your next flight.
book.hexerei.items_broom_stand_2.passage: With its sturdy construction and elegant design, the Broom Stand ensures your broom is always within reach and neatly stored.
book.hexerei.items_broom_waterproof_tip_: Have a base underwater but tired of falling off your broom and not being able to use it? Try the waterproof tip! This allows the player to stay on the broom while riding underwater. It fits into the Misc slot.
book.hexerei.items_broom_whistle_1.passa: The Broom Whistle is a handy tool for any witch. Bind it to your broom, and with a simple blow, your broom will come flying to you if it’s within range. Perfect for those moments when you need your broom in a hurry, it ensures you’re never far from your trusty ride.
book.hexerei.items_candelabra_1.passage_: Candelabras, unlike the candles used to make them, won't go out on their own. They can be placed on the top of a block, or under a block, including blocks like chains.
book.hexerei.items_candle_1.passage_2: Candles are a dyeable, decorative block which can be used for lighting, or for magic. Up to 4 different candles can be placed in the same block. A candle can be lit with flint and steel, and will typically stay lit for 35 minutes.
book.hexerei.items_candle_3.passage_1:
Candles are lit individually, in the order they were placed in. When placed near an altar and lit, the candles will float around it.
  You can craft several items with a candle to add a decorative base to it, including planks, selenite shards, and more.
book.hexerei.items_candle_4.passage_1: Candles can be infused with a potion effect with a Dipper. When lit, they will apply their effects to anyone nearby. Only certain potions work for this.
book.hexerei.items_cloth_1.passage_2: The Cloth is what clears the waxed blocks and unwaxes them. This has unlimited uses unlike the Wax Blend. Waxed connectable blocks can only connect to other waxed connectable blocks, from this mod.
book.hexerei.items_coffer_1.passage_2: The Coffer is a very useful storage device for witches, especially those who have crow familiars.
book.hexerei.items_coffer_2.passage_1: To craft you need a Mixing Cauldron and the items shown below.
book.hexerei.items_coffer_3.passage_1: Coffers can also be dyed with any color and be renamed to change their colors in a loop.
book.hexerei.items_coffer_3.passage_2: Once dyed, if not named, they can be dyed again to mix the dye colors like leather armor.
book.hexerei.items_coffer_4.passage_1:
When punched, a placed coffer will be picked up into your inventory, keeping their items, name, and colors.

  On the right side of the coffer's GUI is a button with a crow on it.
book.hexerei.items_coffer_5.passage_1:
While toggled, the crow button will allow crows on gather mode to check items inside the coffer and look in the area for items matching its contents to deposit. 

  Crows with a perch located on a coffer will pick up any item in the area and return it to that coffer.
book.hexerei.items_courier_depot_1.passa: Courier Depots serve as a crucial center for managing all your deliveries. With its efficient design and charming aesthetics, it ensures that every parcel and message is handled with utmost care and precision.
book.hexerei.items_courier_depot_2.passa:
Staffed by owls who not only deliver with pinpoint accuracy but also have a knack for gossiping about the latest magical news, it’s the perfect solution for any witch looking to keep their messages flying smoothly and with a touch of whimsy.

 Comes in each wood variant.
book.hexerei.items_courier_letter_1.pass: Courier Letters are great for sending secret messages to other players or depots. Whether you’re sharing important information or just keeping in touch, this enchanted letter ensures your message arrives swiftly and securely.
book.hexerei.items_courier_letter_2.pass: Delivered by our trusty owls, your words will always find their way to the intended recipient, no matter the distance.
book.hexerei.items_courier_package_1.pas: Courier Packages are perfect for sending items to other players or depots. Whether it’s a gift, supplies, or a special delivery, these enchanted packages ensure your items arrive safely and promptly.
book.hexerei.items_courier_package_2.pas:
Delivered by our dedicated owls, your parcels will always reach their destination, no matter the distance or obstacles. 
  Packages can be opened by right clicking the placed package, if that package is sealed.
book.hexerei.items_crow_flute_1.passage_: The Crow Flute is an essential item for controlling your crow companions. It has a menu for assigning commands, selecting crows, and setting a crow's perch position.
book.hexerei.items_crystal_ball_1.passag: The Crystal Ball is a useful tool, able to reveal the phase of the moon, or the sun if it's daytime. Handy for crafting moon dust!
book.hexerei.items_dipper_1.passage_2: The Dipper is an attachment for the Mixing Cauldron, mainly used for making candles by dipping string into the tallow below. To attach, sneak and right click the top of the cauldron with the dipper.
book.hexerei.items_dipper_3.passage_1: The Dipper has 3 slots, each of which can hold a single item. If the fluid below matches a recipe for one of the items on the dipper, it will begin dipping it in the fluid. The Dipper is not just for candlemaking, it is able to make any item in any fluid, so long as the recipe exists.
book.hexerei.items_dowsing_rod_1.passage: The Dowsing Rod is able to locate certain biomes containing the needed plants for the witch to begin their craft. Sneak right click to flip between searching for Swamps and Jungles. Right clicking will make the rod look for a new biome of the selected type.
book.hexerei.items_dried_belladonna_flow: The dried variant of the belladonna flowers, this does not have any uses yet but will be used in various blends and in rituals in the future.
book.hexerei.items_dried_mandrake_flower: The dried variant of the mandrake flowers, this does not have any uses yet but will be used in various blends and in rituals in the future.
book.hexerei.items_dried_mugwort_flowers: The dried variant of the mugwort flowers, this does not have any uses yet but will be used in various blends and in rituals in the future.
book.hexerei.items_dried_mugwort_leaves_: The dried variant of the mugwort leaves, this does not have any uses yet but will be used in various blends and in rituals in the future.
book.hexerei.items_dried_sage_bundle_1.p: This bundle is now useful in the Sage Burning Plate. To use simply right click your bundle onto the plate, once the bundle is on the plate it can be lit with flint and steel. This is the fuel to cleansing the area of spawning mobs within it.
book.hexerei.items_dried_yellow_dock_flo: The dried variant of the yellow dock flowers, this does not have any uses yet but will be used in various blends and in rituals in the future.
book.hexerei.items_dried_yellow_dock_lea: The dried variant of the yellow dock leaves, this does not have any uses yet but will be used in various blends and in rituals in the future.
book.hexerei.items_drying_rack_1.passage: Special racks for the drying of items and herbs, or holding items for decoration. Right click a drying rack to place what you are holding on it.
book.hexerei.items_drying_rack_3.passage:
There are 3 separate slots in the drying rack, each slot can hold up to 3 of that item. Each time you right click it with an item in hand, it will take up to 3 of those items and place it into the drying rack.
  To remove all items from the drying rack that arent crafting, both hands must be bare and you crouch and right click the drying rack.
book.hexerei.items_drying_rack_4.passage:
You can also simply right click to remove items that have completed their drying process, no crouching necessary.
  Automation can be done using item transportation blocks, like hoppers or item pipes.
book.hexerei.items_ender_satchel_1.passa: The Ender Satchel is a unique type of satchel. When this inventory is opened it links with the riders ender chest.
A really nice decoration item to decorate your own ponds or rivers with.
book.hexerei.items_gold_rings_1.passage_: A cosmetic attachment for brooms, adding a set of gold rings to their tip. These fit in the Misc slot.
book.hexerei.items_herb_enhanced_broom_b: A longer lasting brush, enhanced by the herbs in its crafting. By default, it is able to fuel a broom's flight for twice as long.
book.hexerei.items_herb_jar_1.passage_2:
The Herb Jar is perfect for the witch who wants to keep ingredients in bulk. It can hold up to 1024 items of one type.
  Like coffers, herb jars also have a crow button, letting your crows keep your herb collection neat and tidy.
book.hexerei.items_herb_jar_2.passage_1:
The jar's GUI may be opened by right-clicking on any face but the front. To access it from the front, sneak and right-click with an empty hand.
  Left-click the front face to take out one item, or left-click while sneaking to take out a stack at a time.
book.hexerei.items_herb_jar_3.passage_1: To craft you need a Mixing Cauldron and the items shown below.
book.hexerei.items_herb_jar_4.passage_1: Herb Jars can also be dyed with any color and be renamed to change their colors in a loop.
book.hexerei.items_herb_jar_4.passage_2: Once dyed, if not named, they can be dyed again to mix the dye colors like leather armor.
book.hexerei.items_index_page_1.passage_:
This chapter is all about the items in the witching world, how you obtain them, and what you do with them. 

  Click an item on the following index pages, or anywhere you see an item displayed, to flip to the entry on that item.
book.hexerei.items_infused_fabric_1.pass: Infused Fabric is used to craft the witch armor set, and can be made into decorative blocks and carpets.
book.hexerei.items_infused_fabric_block_: Infused Fabric Blocks are versatile and enchanting, perfect for adding a magical touch to any build. They can be dyed in a variety of colors and connect with a full sided connection, allowing for endless customization and creativity.
Can be dyed when the block is placed, then by using any dye against the block.
Can be waxed to connect to other waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_infused_fabric_carpet: Enhance your builds with infused fabric carpets, which are both captivating and practical. They can be dyed in a variety of colors and connect seamlessly on the same layer, allowing for endless customization and creativity.
Can be dyed when the carpet is placed, then by using any dye against the carpet.
Can be placed on carpets and stairs to form fit most of them.
book.hexerei.items_large_satchel_1.passa: The Large Satchel is the highest tier of satchel. This one adds 27 storage slots to the broom. It fits into the Satchel slot.
book.hexerei.items_mahogany_broom_1.pass: The fastest of the three brooms. The mahogany broom as an item is fire resistant, similarly to the netherite in its creation. This doesn't protect against accidents when flying the broom into these things, unless the broom has a netherite tip attachment.
These planks have a full sided connected texture. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_mahogany_log_1.passag: Mahogany Logs are used in the making of a mahogany broom within the mixing cauldron. Also a very good decoration block with its very rich mahogany color.
book.hexerei.items_mahogany_planks_1.pas: Mahogany Planks and its variants are great decoration pieces to give a nice warm wood to use in cosy builds.
book.hexerei.items_mahogany_sapling_1.pa:
Sapling used to grow Mahogany trees. Can be obtained by breaking Mahogany Leaves. 

  Mahogany trees can be found in jungles.
book.hexerei.items_mahogany_window_1.pas: These windows have a full sided connected texture. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_mahogany_window_pane_: These windows have a full sided connected texture. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_mandrake_flowers_1.pa:
Mandrake flowers are used in the recipe to make the herb enhanced broom brush, they can also be dried and later on will be used in different infuses and rituals.
  Obtained by right clicking a fully grown Mandrake Plant.
book.hexerei.items_mandrake_plant_1.pass: One of the flowers of Hexerei, the Mandrake, can be harvested by simply right clicking it when it is fully grown just like a sweet berry bush. Can be harvested when fully grown by right clicking just like a sweet berry bush.
book.hexerei.items_mandrake_root_1.passa:
The root of the Mandrake Plant, used as an essential part for building the broom brushes as well as crafting the broom itself. It will have future uses of turning it into oils or using the root in certain recipes.
  Obtained by right clicking a fully grown Mandrake Plant.
book.hexerei.items_medium_satchel_1.pass: The Medium Satchel is the second tier of satchel. This satchel adds 18 storage slots to the broom. It fits into the Satchel slot.
book.hexerei.items_mindful_trance_blend_: A blend that can be applied to candles.
book.hexerei.items_mixing_cauldron_1.pas: The Mixing Cauldron is one of the main tools in the witch's arsenal, mixing up all sorts of crafts and potions.
book.hexerei.items_mixing_cauldron_3.pas: Items can be thrown onto the cauldron from the top to fill its slots, or automatically filled with any item transporting block (i.e. hoppers, pipes from other mods). It also has a GUI for putting items in manually.
book.hexerei.items_mixing_cauldron_4.pas:
You can click the center of the GUI to view all the recipes, if JEI is installed. While scrolling through JEI, you can click the + button to transfer over your items for easy crafting.

  The slot on the top left is for Sigils, such as the Blood Sigil.
book.hexerei.items_mixing_cauldron_5.pas:
The cauldron can hold up to two buckets of any kind of fluid. Fluid can be pumped in with other mods' pipes, or you can use bottles or buckets on the cauldron. 
  Some recipes also require a heat source under the cauldron, like fire, lava, campfires, or magma blocks.
book.hexerei.items_mixing_cauldron_6.pas: The cauldron has other uses when certain attachments are put on it. The Dipper can make candles when the cauldron is full of tallow, or can collect blood with a Blood Sigil. Click the items below for more info.
book.hexerei.items_mixing_cauldron_7.pas:
The mixing cauldron can brew up to two buckets worth of potions at a time, when heated.
  To do this, fill it with water, then add two of the ingredient needed to make the potion. For example, making Awkward Potion requires two nether wart.
book.hexerei.items_moon_dust_brush_1.pas: This Broom Brush makes the broom faster, especially during the full moon. It is otherwise the same as the Enhanced Broom Brush.
book.hexerei.items_mugwort_bush_1.passag: A bush flower of Hexerei, the Mugwort, has been used to open up a more direct channel to the lunar side of magic. This has no uses for magic yet, these will come at a later date. Can be harvested when fully grown by right clicking.
book.hexerei.items_mugwort_flowers_1.pas:
Mugwort flowers are used in the recipe to make the herb enhanced broom brush, they can also be dried and later on will be used in different infuses and rituals.
  Obtained by right clicking a fully grown Mugwort Bush.
book.hexerei.items_mugwort_leaves_1.pass:
Mugwort Leaves are used in the recipe to make the normal broom brush, they can also be dried and later on will be used in different infuses and rituals.
  Obtained by right clicking a fully grown Mugwort Bush.
Currently, just a cosmetic variant of the regular witch's hat.
book.hexerei.items_packing_peanut_1.pass: Packing Peanuts are not only perfect for cushioning your Courier Packages but also make for a delightful light snack. A favorite among our hardworking owls, they add a touch of fun to every parcel.
book.hexerei.items_pestle_and_mortar_1.p: The Pestle and Mortar is used for smashing, smooshing, grinding, and turning things into a fine paste. This will be used for making the blends and pastes for infusing your candles to give them effects while lit. It is also used to create the crows favorite snackies!
book.hexerei.items_pestle_and_mortar_3.p: Right click while holding an item to add one of it to the mortar, or sneak right click to insert the entire stack. Items can be taken back by sneak right clicking. Once all items for a recipe are inside, you can no longer take items out. When the craft has finished, the result can be simply right clicked out.
book.hexerei.items_polished_mahogany_con: These planks have a full sided connected texture. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_polished_mahogany_lay: These planks have layered connections, and will connect other connections on the same level it is on. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_polished_mahogany_pil: These planks have pillar connections, and will connect to similar faced pillars. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_polished_willow_conne: These planks have a full sided connected texture. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_polished_willow_layer: These planks have layered connections, and will connect other connections on the same level it is on. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_polished_willow_pilla: These planks have pillar connections, and will connect to similar faced pillars. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_polished_witch_hazel_: These planks have a full sided connected texture. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
These planks have layered connections, and will connect other connections on the same level it is on. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
These planks have pillar connections, and will connect to similar faced pillars. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_reading_glasses_1.pas: Need help reading the book? want to just slightly zoom into the book to better look at images? Well these are the glasses for you! Acts like a spyglass when holding the item and right clicking, but zooms in just a bit. You can also put these on your head and press %kkey.hexerei.glasses_zoom to toggle zoom in.
book.hexerei.items_replacer_satchel_1.pa:
The Replacer Satchel is another satchel that is the size of a Medium Satchel, though this one has some upgrades. 
  This satchel allows broom brushes that are stored in it to replace the active brush when it breaks.
book.hexerei.items_sage_1.passage_2: The Sage Leaf is obtained by farming the sage crop. Sage is a very useful herb in witchery as it is used to cleanse the area of evil spirits. This sage can be burned if bundled up and then dried.
book.hexerei.items_sage_bundle_1.passage: This bundle is not quite useful yet, first needs to be dried before use in the Sage Burning Plate.
The Sage Burning Plate can protect the witch's home from monsters. Simply place one down, fill it with a bundle of dried sage, and light it to prevent monster spawns.
  By default, its effect reaches in a 48 block radius around the plate.
To craft you need a Mixing Cauldron and the items shown below.
Sage smoke will appear randomly in the area when a bundle is lit. The smoke particles can be changed or turned off by right clicking the plate with a bare hand.
  The smoke has 4 different modes it can be set to. The ring of smoke shows the range it will reach and the others are for aesthetic.
book.hexerei.items_sage_seed_1.passage_2: Sage seeds can be found by breaking grass, similar to wheat seeds. When planted on farmland they will grow into sage crops.
book.hexerei.items_seed_mixture_1.passag: A blend of seeds perfect for taming wild crows to act as familiars.
book.hexerei.items_small_satchel_1.passa: Satchels allow the broom to store items. This one adds 9 storage slots to the broom. It fits into the Satchel slot.
book.hexerei.items_warhammer_1.passage_2: Wait a minute, this isn't a witchy item. Looks like this is more for someone like the god of thunder. Maybe a crow would like to use this item. If not, it's quite good for bashing things in the face.
book.hexerei.items_wax_blend_1.passage_2: Wax blend is to wax unwaxed connectable blocks. Waxed connectable blocks can only connect to other waxed connectable blocks, from this mod.
book.hexerei.items_waxing_kit_1.passage_: The Waxing Kit is both a Cloth and a bunch of Wax Blend. This must be loaded with Wax Blends before it can apply wax, but it can always take away wax. Waxed connectable blocks can only connect to other waxed connectable blocks, from this mod.
book.hexerei.items_wet_broom_brush_1.pas: To make a broom brush, you must first craft the wet one within a cauldron, then set it to dry in a drying rack. When finished drying, the new brush can be put on a broom.
book.hexerei.items_wet_herb_enhanced_bro: Like the normal brush, this is made in the mixing cauldron and must be dried before use.
book.hexerei.items_wet_moon_dust_brush_1: Like the other brushes, the Moon Dust Brush is made in the mixing cauldron and must be dried before use.
book.hexerei.items_willow_broom_1.passag: A witch's main tool of transportation. There are three types of brooms, the willow being the slowest, but also cheapest, of them. Brooms have three slots for upgrades: Misc, Satchel, and Brush. The brush is what allows the broom to fly, and one comes with every fresh broom made.
book.hexerei.items_willow_broom_3.passag: To access the broom's inventory, sneak right click while the broom is placed down. During flight, the broom's brush gets damaged and can break. So, for longer journeys, it is advised to bring extra brushes.
book.hexerei.items_willow_broom_4.passag: The best way is to stash these extra brushes within the broom's satchel. Adding a small satchel will add 9 extra slots to hold items within, and each tier above will hold an additional 9 slots.
book.hexerei.items_willow_connected_1.pa: These planks have a full sided connected texture. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_willow_log_1.passage_: Willow logs are used in making a willow broom within the mixing cauldron. They are also a lovely decoration block for a more gloomy or nature-like builds.
book.hexerei.items_willow_planks_1.passa: Willow planks and its variants are great decoration pieces as they bring in a nice green wood for more nature-like builds.
book.hexerei.items_willow_sapling_1.pass:
Sapling used to grow Willow trees. Can be obtained by breaking Willow Leaves. 

  Willow trees can be found in swamps.
book.hexerei.items_willow_window_1.passa: These windows have a full sided connected texture. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
These windows have a full sided connected texture. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_witch_boots_1.passage: A witch's classic pair of boots, giving a few perks when the full set is worn. Each piece can be dyed to your liking, and renamed to give the color changing effects.
book.hexerei.items_witch_chestplate_1.pa: A witch's classic attire, giving a few perks when the full set is worn. Each piece can be dyed to your liking, and renamed to give the color changing effects.
book.hexerei.items_witch_hazel_broom_1.p: The average of the three brooms. It is faster than the willow broom, and slower than the mahogany, but does not require netherite to craft.
book.hexerei.items_witch_hazel_connected: These planks have a full sided connected texture. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_witch_hazel_log_1.pas: Witch Hazel logs are used in making a willow broom within the mixing cauldron. They are also a lovely decoration block for a more gloomy or nature-like builds.
Witch hazel planks and their variants are perfect with their warm, earthy tones creating a cozy and mystical atmosphere.
book.hexerei.items_witch_hazel_sapling_1:
Sapling used to grow With Hazel trees. Can be obtained by breaking Witch Hazel Leaves. 

  Witch Hazel trees can be found in birch forests.
These windows have a full sided connected texture. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_witch_hazel_window_pa: These windows have a full sided connected texture. Can be waxed with wax blend to connect with other similar waxed blocks.
book.hexerei.items_witch_helmet_1.passag: A witch's classic hat, giving a few perks when the full set is worn. Each piece can be dyed to your liking, and renamed to give the color changing effects.
book.hexerei.items_woodcutter_1.passage_: The Woodcutter is essential for transforming wood and planks into special connecting texture blocks or getting a nice discount on other blocks. Perfect for any witch looking to add unique patterns and designs to their builds, it ensures precision and creativity in every cut.
book.hexerei.items_woodcutter_2.passage_: With its magical efficiency, crafting intricate wooden structures has never been easier.
book.hexerei.items_woodcutter_planks: * Use a woodcutter to cut the planks into special connecting variants
book.hexerei.items_yellow_dock_bush_1.pa: The last bush flower of Hexerei, the Yellow Dock, has been used to break binding ties that prevent those from moving on. This will be used in sorts of magic for the spirit coven, which will be coming in future updates. Can be harvested when fully grown by right clicking.
book.hexerei.items_yellow_dock_flowers_1:
Yellow Dock flowers are used in the recipe to make the herb enhanced broom brush, they can also be dried and later on will be used in different infuses and rituals.
  Obtained by right clicking a fully grown Yellow Dock Bush.
Yellow Dock Leaves are used in the recipe to make the normal broom brush, they can also be dried and later on will be used in different infuses and rituals.
  Obtained by right clicking a fully grown Yellow Dock Bush.
book.hexerei.structures_dark_coven_page_: Swamps are also the home of Dark Covens, structures similar to villages, but for the witches of their coven.
You can find various crafting tools, armor, and herbs within the covens.
book.hexerei.structures_index_page_1.pas: Numerous structures dot the world wherein witches praxtice their art. The pages in this chapter will inform where to find these places, and what they might be useful for.
book.hexerei.structures_nature_coven_pag: The Nature Coven is dedicated to the power of the natural world. Found in forests, members excel in earth-based magic, nurturing plants, and communicating with animals. Perfect for that naturey witch.
These places are a good source for witch tools, crows, bees, and herbs.
book.hexerei.structures_owl_post_office_: The Owl Post Office, nestled in the heart of the forest, is where diligent owls manage all your magical deliveries. Efficient and reliable, these feathered couriers ensure your messages and parcels reach their destinations swiftly and securely.
Tame owls to assist with deliveries and open packages for enchanting rewards.
Or use it as a great starter base with a perfect second floor for brooms.
book.hexerei.structures_witch_hut_page_1: Throughout the swamps, you may come across different variations of witch huts. These huts are home to witches and their tools.
book.hexerei.structures_witch_hut_page_2: A great place to start off as an aspiring witch!
book.hexerei.support_page_1.passage_1:
This mod has come a long way due to this community, and will continue to strive because of it. Come be a part of it and join our Discord!
  If you have any questions feel free to join and ask for help as we do have a very friendly community!
book.hexerei.support_page_2.ko-fi_link_t: really this does help feed me <3

To be able to achieve such feats for this mod, I do put in all of my time and effort into this. Donations do help a ton as it is my only means of survival and I do wish to continue to work on this mod as much as possible!
  All of these donations go towards me being able to live and if I have any leftover to put back into the mod or community!

book.hexerei.support_page_3.passage_1: Another way to help support Hexerei is by becoming a patron. Being a patron gives you access to having your dye-able witch outfits glow when wearing them! This effect looks best with shaders at night.
book.hexerei.support_page_4.passage_1:
Lastly you can support me on Ko-fi. These methods do help me tons in terms of being able to continue to do this constantly while being able to sustain life and I appreciate it greatly!

  With all that being said, I hope you enjoy the the enchanting world of Hexerei!

tooltip.hexerei.broom_whistle_shift_2: To unbind place the whistle back into the crafting grid.

tooltip.hexerei.candle_dipper_shift_1: Поместите над ведьминским котлом, наполненным жиром, положите в него 3 нитки, и он начнёт производство свечей.
tooltip.hexerei.candle_dipper_shift_2: Щелкните правой кнопкой мыши пустой рукой, чтобы забрать готовые свечи.

tooltip.hexerei.candle_shift_2: В один блок можно разместить до 4 свечей разных цветов
